name: EPIC 205983689
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 5.4 solar radii and 0.95 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205983689 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 5.353178 (16th-84th percentiles 5.189842-5.531652), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205983689: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4854.2803 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205983689 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1712.285156 (16th-84th percentiles 1667.949219-1758.789062), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,712 parsecs away, 5 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.95 solar masses and 5.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,854 K at its surface.
